auth: 1. Organization Admin: Snap Business Manager → Business Details → create an OAuth app (name + `redirect_uri`); `client_id` shown, `client_secret` only at creation.

reference.limits: - Rate limits are not stated on the pages read (TODO(verify) — API Reference). Free API; Snap Developer Terms + Snap Business Tools Terms accepted when creating the app. - Money fields are in micro-currency (Monetary Values page).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth client id of your Snap Business Manager app (Business Details > OAuth apps).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth app's client secret (form body of the refresh request).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from one authorization-code consent with scope snapchat-marketing-api (https://developers.snap.com/api/marketing-api/Ads-API/authentication); 60-minute access tokens are minted from it.

config_fields.name: organization_id
config_fields.help: Snap organization id whose ad accounts list_accounts returns (GET /v1/me/organizations).

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: Ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

config_fields.name: tz_offset
config_fields.help: UTC offset of the ad account time zone, e.g. -07:00 or +01:00, used to build day-aligned start_time/end_time for get_report (Snap requires daily boundaries in the account time zone).

me.note: GET /v1/me: the authenticated Snap user {me: {id, email, organization_id, display_name}}.

list_accounts.note: GET /v1/organizations/{organization_id config}/adaccounts: the organization's ad accounts (currency and timezone per account).

list_campaigns.note: GET /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns?limit= (50-1000; first page only, paging.next_link). Budgets are micro-currency: budget_micros is daily_budget_micro (1,000,000 = 1 unit of the account currency). `status` (ACTIVE, PAUSED) is not a filter.

get_report.note: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}/stats?granularity=DAY&fields=impressions,swipes,spend with start_time/end_time at midnight in the account time zone (tz_offset config). campaign_id is required. end_time is an exclusive day boundary: pass date_to as the day AFTER the last day wanted. spend is micro-currency; metrics are final 48 hours after the day ends.

pause_resume.note: PATCH /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} (application/json-patch+json) [{op: replace, path: /status, value: PAUSED|ACTIVE}]. Resuming restarts spending.

not_offered.update_budget: Snap budgets are micro-currency integers ("daily_budget_micro: Daily Spend Cap (micro-currency)", minimum 20,000,000, https://developers.snap.com/api/marketing-api/Ads-API/campaigns); the adapter cannot scale a daily_budget into micros.
